title: Rose Bridal Henna Cones (Pack of 12)
description: Hand-rolled, chemical-free henna paste with a fine tip for bridal detailing. Deep maroon stain that matures over 24–48 hours. Sealed pack of 12 cones, freshly made to order.

title: Triple-Sifted Organic Henna Powder (100g)
description: Rajasthani crop, triple-sifted to 300 mesh for a smooth, clog-free paste. Natural dye content, no PPD, no additives. Resealable pouch, 100g.

title: Eucalyptus Essential Oil for Henna (15ml)
description: Steam-distilled eucalyptus oil with high cineole content to deepen and speed up henna stain. Dropper cap, 15ml.

title: Cone Filling Kit — Bottle, Nozzles & Stand
description: Everything to roll your own cones: applicator bottle, 5 metal nozzles in assorted gauges, cone stand and 50 pre-cut cellophane sheets.

title: Henna Aftercare Balm (25g)
description: Beeswax and shea balm to seal a dry henna design, lock in moisture and darken the final stain. Fragrance-free, 25g tin.

title: Silicone Practice Hand — Life Size
description: Skin-tone silicone hand with realistic flex and texture for practising bridal patterns. Wipes clean, reusable for years.

title: DIY Mehndi Kit — Mini
description: Two ready-to-use henna cones, a design card and aftercare sachet. Perfect for festivals and first-timers.

title: Jagua Temporary Tattoo Gel (20ml)
description: Fruit-based jagua gel that stains blue-black for a fresh-ink look. Vegan, PPD-free. Applicator bottle, 20ml.
